notes: ACCESS: ampm.fr 301-redirects to https://www.laredoute.fr/pplp/cat-85201.aspx - AM.PM is sold as a brand-filtered subtree of La Redoute's French platform (same finding as the prior Home-Decor pass, archive c105). Direct curl and translate.goog both return the Cloudflare 'Country challenge' 403; r.jina.ai reached robots.txt but is also country-challenged on /pplp/ pages. WebFetch renders past the interstitial and was the sole working route for every page, matching the prior pass. robots.txt (read via r.jina.ai) names no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web directive, so no Claude-specific disallow applies. All links are laredoute.fr by design; ampm.fr serves no independent catalogue. TREE: taken from the AM.PM hub cat-85201 mega-nav plus each page's own left sidebar. The furniture department is 'Meuble' (cat-285787; the intermediate ids 175031/175040/85267 all resolve to the same Meuble hub). Its children are Armoire/commode/dressing, Bibliotheque/etagere, Meuble modulable, Meuble TV/buffet/vaisselier, Console, Bureau, plus the three sibling hubs Canape-fauteuil (cat-390319), Table-chaise (cat-390320) and Lit-literie (cat-390353). Garden furniture sits in its own 'Meubles de jardin' hub (cat-85272) under Jardin. COUNTS: every qty is the rendered total shown immediately above the product grid on that node's own page (La Redoute prints it as a bare numeral next to the sort/filter bar, with no 'articles'/'produits' word). EXHAUSTION CHECKS: Table-chaise parent header 345 = 68 (Table) + 90 (Chaise) + 76 (Table basse) + 67 (Bout de canape) + 44 (Console) exactly - a clean children-sum-to-parent proof that these are true node totals and that the shared 'Table de chevet' cross-link is not double counted there. Canape-fauteuil parent 1607 = 1076 (Canape) + 210 (Fauteuil) + 133 (Pouf) + 67 (Bout de canape) + 121 (Housse de canape, excluded) exactly. Garden parent 98 covers 17+25+35 kept plus the excluded Decoration d'exterieure remainder. The five Canape sub-types and the three Meuble modulable sub-types are NOT mutually exclusive (1454 vs 1076, and 112 vs 105) - each child count is exact for its own node but they must not be summed; flagged on the two grouping rows. DRIFT: Canape droit 659, Canape 1076, Fauteuil 210, Armoire/commode 107 and Salon de jardin 17 were each re-read a second time with a cache-busting query string and reproduced identically. DEDUPE: 'Bout de canape' and 'Console' each appear in two sidebars and 'Bureau modulable' in two; each is emitted exactly once. EXCLUDED: Housse de canape (sofa covers - furniture covers); Couette/oreiller (duvets and pillows) and Cache-sommier/housse de tete de lit (bed valances) under Lit-literie - bedding/textiles; the duplicate Table de chevet cross-link inside Table-chaise (kept once as Bedside Tables under Beds); Lampe de bureau and Luminaire exterieur (lighting); Decoration d'exterieure (outdoor decor roll-up - planters, lanterns, outdoor rug); Miroir, Deco murale, Objet de decoration, Cache-pot/vase, Bougeoir, Papier peint, Tapis, Coussin, Rideaux, Boutis/plaid, Art de la table and Linge de maison (all decor, textile or tableware). 'Rangement deco' (76) and its child 'Porte manteau, patere' (27) were opened and title-scanned: the parent is baskets, boxes and trunks plus coat items, and the child is 9 wall-hook sets to 6 freestanding coat stands in the first 15 tiles - majority standalone storage and wall hardware, so dropped per the mixed-roll-up rule. No bathroom-furniture, kids/nursery-furniture, bench or stool node exists on the AM.PM nav. Marketing pages (ampm-collection-canapes, ampm-canapealacarte, ampm-tablealacarte, ampm-collection-mobilier-de-jardin, Nouveautes) were excluded as collection/landing pages.
